entries.title: A merge card updates while its checks run
entries.body: When you ask a crewmate for a change after its merge card is up, it now updates that card right away, even while the checks run again. Merge then reads Merge when checks pass, and a click waits for them. Before, the card kept its old words until the checks passed.
entries.noPicture: The card looks the same; what changed is that its new words reach you while the checks run.
